extractor: read directly from the official IND page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: The salary thresholds. IND links a separate income page; the highly skilled migrant amounts change every January, and recalling one would be a fabricated threshold on a page that does not state it.
The general requirements that apply to everyone. Linked, not stated.
The public register of recognised sponsors. Linked; it is a live list rather than a requirement.
The BIG Act article 3 and 36a profession lists, and the conditional-registration route for foreign diplomas. Linked to the BIG register's own site.
Fee exceptions. IND links a fees page; only the headline € 423,00 is recorded.

requirements.label: Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit
requirements.description: Structural, as with the student permit: the applicant cannot lodge this themselves.
requirements.source_excerpt: only an employer recognised by the ind can apply for your permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Only an employer recognised by the IND can apply for your permit.

requirements.label: Meet the general requirements that apply to everyone
requirements.description: IND links a separate general-requirements page, which is not a registered source.
requirements.source_excerpt: you meet the general requirements that apply to everyone .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You meet the general requirements that apply to everyone.

requirements.label: Hold an employment contract with a Dutch employer or research institution
requirements.source_excerpt: you have an employment contract with an employer or research institution in the netherlands.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You have an employment contract with an employer or research institution in the Netherlands.

requirements.label: The employer must be an IND-recognised sponsor, listed in the public register
requirements.source_excerpt: this employer is a sponsor recognised by the ind . a recognised sponsor is listed in the public register of recognised sponsors .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: This employer is a sponsor recognised by the IND. A recognised sponsor is listed in the public register of recognised sponsors.

requirements.label: Meet the income requirements
requirements.description: No figure recorded. IND links a separate income page that is not a registered source, and the highly skilled migrant salary thresholds change every January. Recalling a euro amount here would be a fabricated threshold.

requirements.label: The agreed salary must be in line with the market rate
requirements.source_excerpt: the agreed salary is in line with the market rate. in line with the market rate means that you earn the same as what people in the same job earn on average.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The agreed salary is in line with the market rate. In line with the market rate means that you earn the same as what people in the same job earn on average.

requirements.label: Healthcare professionals must be registered in the BIG register
requirements.description: Occupation-specific. VisaAI has an occupation fact but not one that maps to the BIG Act's article 3 and 36a lists, so no rule is attached rather than gate it wrongly.
requirements.source_excerpt: are you going to work in individual healthcare? and do you practise a medical profession that is listed in article 3 and article 36a of the individual healthcare professions act (big act)? if so, you must be registered in the big register.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Are you going to work in individual healthcare? And do you practise a medical profession that is listed in Article 3 and Article 36a of the Individual Healthcare Professions Act (BIG Act)? If so, you must be registered in the BIG register.

requirements.label: Foreign documents must be legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German
requirements.source_excerpt: have foreign documents legalised and translated into dutch, english, french or german.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Have foreign documents legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German.

requirements.label: Your employer holds the list of documents you need
requirements.description: IND publishes no applicant-facing document list for this route; the recognised sponsor holds it. This is a FACT ABOUT THE PROCESS, not a document the applicant obtains, so it must not appear as a checklist row — see the note in 20260821490000.
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer has a list of documents that you need.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer has a list of documents that you need.

requirements.label: Your employer applies for the mvv and the residence permit at the same time
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer applies for the mvv and the residence permit at the same time.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer applies for the MVV and the residence permit at the same time.

requirements.label: If you are already in the Netherlands, your employer must apply within 3 months of your arrival
requirements.source_excerpt: then your employer must do this within 3 months after you have travelled to the netherlands.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Then your employer must do this within 3 months after you have travelled to the Netherlands.

requirements.label: Application fee
requirements.description: Paid by the employer by direct debit, not by the applicant.
requirements.source_excerpt: the application costs € 423,00. for all fees and exceptions visit our web page fees: costs of an application . your employer pays automatically by direct debit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The application costs € 423,00. For all fees and exceptions visit our web page Fees: costs of an application. Your employer pays automatically by direct debit.

requirements.label: The IND decides within 90 days
requirements.description: A service commitment rather than an applicant obligation, and IND states it may be extended. Note this is 90 days, against 60 for the student permit.
requirements.source_excerpt: the ind must take a decision within 90 days. this is called the decision period. we can extend the decision period if it takes longer to decide.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The IND must take a decision within 90 days. This is called the decision period. We can extend the decision period if it takes longer to decide.

requirements.label: Transferees from a company outside the EU are intra corporate transferees, with different requirements
requirements.description: Recorded so someone on a transfer is not led through the wrong route. IND treats it as a separate permit.
requirements.source_excerpt: do you have an employment contract with a company located outside the eu? and are you going to be transferred as a manager, specialist or trainee? then you are an intra corporate transferee and other requirements apply to you.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Do you have an employment contract with a company located outside the EU? And are you going to be transferred as a manager, specialist or trainee? Then you are an intra corporate transferee and other requirements apply to you.
